structured_output.title: New `ciss` short name for ClusterIssuer resource
structured_output.content: cert-manager v1.18.0 adds the short name `ciss` as an alias for `ClusterIssuer` resources. This is a kubectl convenience feature and does not affect runtime behavior. Your environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 and shows `Certificate` resources in use, but the installed CRD list is incomplete (`crds=absent`). Inspect whether your environment uses `ClusterIssuer` resources and whether the CRD is installed; if it is, the new short name will be available after upgrade at no cost or risk.
